column1: # Rule: One row = one complete entry (one repo + one domain + one server for one suborg/app).
# Each column must be filled on every row.
# organization_name   : Your company name (fill only on first row
# application_name    : Application or service name within that unit
# repo_url            : Full GitHub/GitLab URL of the repository
# repo_name           : Short display name for the repo
# branch_to_scan      : Branch to run PQC scan on (e.g. main
# domain              : Domain/hostname to run TLS scan on (no https://)
